# Qualified SWPPP Practitioner (QSP) & Preparer Training

> Qualified SWPPP Practitioner (QSP) & Preparer Training: 2 self-paced online courses from $379.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Qualified SWPPP Practitioner (QSP) & Preparer Training and wants to compare the courses, prices and lengths, or enroll.
- Each course entry below lists the price per seat, the length, the regulation it follows and an enroll link that opens the checkout.
- For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://stormwater-swppp.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Qualified SWPPP Practitioner (QSP) Training](https://stormwater-swppp.hazwoperosha.us/#course-440): $379.99 per person, 7 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 24 months. In accordance with Clean Water Act Section 402 and 40 CFR122.26. Enroll: https://stormwater-swppp.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=440. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/qualified-swppp-practitioner-qsp-training
